one_line: Early 9th‑century Chandela founder in the Vindhya uplands, a minor Pratihara feudatory who began the rise of Jejakabhukti around Khajuraho.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, lean but wiry, athletic build with the defined arms and shoulders of a cavalry warrior accustomed to both riding and archery.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, medium-brown north Indian complexion, strong jaw, neatly trimmed moustache, faint stubble along the jawline, and a small tilak of red ochre on the forehead; default expression calm and observant, with a slight determined half‑smile that suggests quiet ambition.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair drawn back into a single medium-length topknot (small warrior-style bun) at the back of the crown, with the sides smoothly combed; a narrow dark-red cloth band (like a simple turban strip) wraps once around the head just above the forehead and ties at the back, its short ends tucked near the topknot.
appearance.costume: He wears an early medieval north Indian kshatriya outfit: a knee-length off‑white cotton angarkha-style tunic that overlaps and ties slightly to the right, with long fitted sleeves and a subtle woven border in muted maroon; over this a sleeveless quilted cotton coat (simple padded armour) in dusty olive green with vertical stitching, ending just above the knees; around his waist a broad maroon cotton cummerbund tightly wrapped several times, securing a plain brown leather belt with a simple bronze buckle; his lower body is covered by straight, slightly tapered cotton trousers in muted indigo that gather at the ankles; on his feet are sturdy brown leather ankle boots with a turned-down cuff, suitable for riding; draped from the left shoulder across the torso and looping around the back is a light khaki cotton shawl (uttariya) with a thin dark-red border, practical and modest, resting neatly without obscuring his belt; jewellery is restrained—a single small gold stud in each ear and a plain thin gold armlet on his right upper arm, suggesting emerging but not yet opulent royalty.
appearance.signature: A single recurved composite bow of dark polished wood with horn-reinforced tips, carried unstrung in his left hand along with a simple leather grip, and a cylindrical leather quiver in dull brown hanging at his right hip, filled with feather-fletched arrows whose iron heads are just visible; the bow and quiver together are his defining prop, emphasizing him as a frontier archer-lord rather than a fully imperial king.

ref_desc: Nannuka is a lean mid-30s Chandela warrior with an oval medium-brown face, black hair in a topknot and red headband, wearing an off-white angarkha under an olive quilted coat, maroon waist wrap, indigo trousers, brown boots, khaki shawl, and carrying a dark recurved bow with brown quiver.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Nannuka, early 9th-century Chandela founder from the Vindhya uplands: a lean mid-30s north Indian warrior with an oval medium-brown face, straight nose, strong jaw, neat moustache and light stubble, and a calm determined expression with a small red tilak on his forehead. His thick black hair is pulled into a medium topknot at the back of the crown, with the sides smoothly combed, and a narrow dark-red cloth band wraps once around his head above the forehead, tied at the back near the topknot. He wears an off-white cotton knee-length angarkha-style tunic with long fitted sleeves and a subtle maroon border, under a sleeveless quilted cotton coat in dusty olive green with vertical stitching that ends just above the knees, suggesting practical early medieval armour. Around his waist is a broad maroon cotton cummerbund tightly wrapped several times, over which sits a plain brown leather belt with a simple bronze buckle. His straight, slightly tapered trousers are muted indigo cotton gathered at the ankles, and he wears sturdy brown leather ankle boots with a turned-down cuff suited for riding. A light khaki cotton shawl with a thin dark-red border is draped from his left shoulder across his chest and around his back, hanging modestly and neatly without hiding the belt. Accessories are minimal and period-appropriate: a small gold stud in each ear and a thin plain gold armlet on his right upper arm. His signature prop is a dark polished recurved composite bow with horn-reinforced tips, unstrung and held in his left hand, paired with a dull brown cylindrical leather quiver at his right hip filled with feather-fletched arrows whose iron heads just peek out. Use a restrained earthy palette of off-white, maroon, olive green, muted indigo and brown leather, and present him in neutral front, side and three-quarter poses to clarify his consistent face, hairstyle, clothing and weapons.
